statement: Phase 2 baseline gap is real at every declared coordinate: wave_writes, enforce_boundary and run_wave_parallel carry no prior_written exclusion, main_async never passes frozenset(run_written), the redundant run_written re-annotation remains, and no regression test exists — so earlier-wave writes are re-attributed as unattributed breaches against later CUs.
justification: Advisor-authored: confirms each Phase 2 acceptance criterion (6-9) is net-new work in the current baseline before any fix CU is drafted.
